def checkout(self, cart, customer):
    self.inventory.reserve(cart.items)
    subtotal = 0
    for item in cart.items:
        subtotal += item.price * item.quantity * (1 - item.discount / 100)
    label = customer.first_name + " " + customer.last_name.upper() + " #" + str(cart.id)
    self.mailer.send_receipt(customer.email, label, subtotal)
    self.audit.record("checkout", cart.id)
